subscribe.subscribeSubtitle: Pay a subscription fee to the system admin so your hostel can be listed, monitored, and receive bookings on our site.
subscribe.canNowAdd: You can now add and manage your hostel on our site.
subscribe.feeDescription: This fee is paid by caretakers/hostel owners to the system admin (Dean of Students) to keep their hostels listed, monitored, and receiving bookings on the BU Hostel Booking site.
subscribe.momoInstruction: Send UGX {{amount}} to the admin's mobile money number below, then enter the transaction details.
subscribe.onlyCaretakers: Only caretakers can subscribe to list hostels.

caretakerRegister.termsIntro: Please read and accept these conditions before you continue to add your hostel.
caretakerRegister.listingDesc: Your hostel will be shown on the site immediately. You have 4 days (grace period) to pay the subscription fee of UGX {{price}}. If you do not pay within that time, your hostel will be removed from the site.
caretakerRegister.paymentDesc: Hostel bookings are paid to you directly. If a student does not like their room at check-in, you agree to refund their money.
caretakerRegister.responsibilitiesDesc: Keep your hostel information accurate and up to date, manage your bookings responsibly, and follow the rules of Bugema University.
caretakerRegister.agreeTerms: I have read and agree to the Terms & Conditions above.
caretakerRegister.createSubtitle: Create your caretaker account, list your hostel, and pay the subscription fee — all in one step.

caretakerRegister.step2: Your hostel appears on the site right away. Pay the subscription fee within 4 days to keep it listed.
caretakerRegister.step3: Once the admin verifies your payment, your subscription is activated and your hostel stays on the site.
